reconciliations.name: Inventory roll-forward
reconciliations.formula: Selected roll-forward: €80,000 + €459,000 - €405,000 - €22,000 = €112,000. Alternative physical count: €121,000. The €9,000 difference is unresolved because the evidence does not prove which record is wrong.

uncertainties.alternative: The physical count supports €121,000. If validated, inventory, profit and equity would each be €9,000 higher and provisional net profit would be €74,000.
uncertainties.requiredEvidence: Recount inventory and reconcile SKU quantities, unit costs, purchases and issues to the ledger.
uncertainties.valuationEffect: Open €9,000 upward alternative; neither source is proven wrong.

uncertainties.provisionalTreatment: Record no insurance amount in the provisional statements because no support was supplied.

resolvedJudgments.decision: Use €112,000 provisionally and show €121,000 as the €9,000 alternative.
resolvedJudgments.basis: The selected basis is the roll-forward using documented opening inventory, purchases, €405,000 consumption and the €22,000 write-off. The physical count is independent conflicting evidence, so the difference remains open rather than being called a confirmed counting error.
External counsel identifies €25,000 as the best estimate within the €20,000-€30,000 range.

resolvedJudgments.decision: Record no insurance amount in the provisional statements and retain an unquantified completeness limitation.

€80,000 of equipment was misclassified, while a €10,000 repair was capitalized.
€110,000 of personal owner spending was presented as business spending or payroll.
Payroll, supplier, interest and deposit liabilities were incomplete.
